auth.instructions: Does this change touch authentication, authorization, permissions or user sessions?

payments.instructions: Does this change touch billing, charges, refunds or a payment provider?

dependencies.instructions: Does this change add, remove or upgrade a third-party dependency or lockfile entry?

ci_deploy.instructions: Does this change touch CI pipelines, deployment configuration or release automation?

schema_migration.instructions: Does this change alter a database schema or add a data migration?

email.instructions: Does this change send, template or reroute email or other outbound user messages?

prod_data.instructions: Does this change read, modify or delete production data or real user records?

build_scripts.instructions: Does this change touch build scripts, install hooks or tooling that runs code on developer or CI machines?
